headline: Sep 14 PM · Frankie's Monday PT morning is the live window and both DO-FIRST asks are still open on the record — the hand-dial to Mary Grossman and the one-minute CRM read. Nothing moved since the AM brief: zero new inbox mail all day, and today's Sep 14 digest has not fired yet (14:12Z; it lands ~15:00Z on the same lag), so the scoreboard is still stuck on the fifth identical day. The interpreters stay dark and only the clocks grew — FA-ADS watchdog ~93h, spend-sync silent ~72h with zero successes ever. Compliance 0/7 on day 18, one real lead (NV) sitting behind the gate.

spotlight.title: Mary Grossman — Monday is the live window, seventh ask
spotlight.detail: This is Frankie's PT Monday morning: the first true business-day window since the Fri 6:45 PM PT callback lapsed, now into its third day gone. Two consecutive digests (Sep 12, Sep 13) put the miss on the system of record — 0 booked, 3 unbooked, 3 SLA breached. First real $300-Plan lead (NV), NO TCPA consent → hand-dial only +1 805 302 2655. Close it honestly today with one sentence in a lane: called / referred / held. It stays on the record until a human writes it.

spotlight.title: Open the CRM — the one look that settles two dead instruments
spotlight.detail: Five identical digests mean the scoreboard can no longer tell 'nothing happened' from 'reading a frozen table' — and a sixth is about to print around 15:00Z. One minute in the CRM answers both open unknowns regardless of what the digest says: (a) are there ad-spend rows stamped after Sep 11 13:32Z — w30, the sync question; (b) do the lead rows really show 3 with contact / 3 unbooked / 3 breached, or has the table not been written since Sep 9. Write the two answers into the board; do not infer either from silence.

spotlight.title: Day 18, 0/7 compliance, and the watchdog is now dark ~93 hours
spotlight.detail: Consumer flow went live Aug 27; eighteen days later none of the seven blockers is closed — b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) are the two that gate the lead in hand. The FA-ADS watchdog has not run since Sep 10 17:06Z (~93h), so V2 spend (last read ~$72 of the $200 tranche) has had no reader for nearly four days. State the paid motion plainly — keep spending or hold — or restore what the watchdog runs on. Letting it drain by default is the one choice the board cannot accept.

blockers.label: Scoreboard frozen · 5th day, 6th about to print
blockers.detail: Sep 13 digest (15:00:08Z) is identical to Sep 10, 11, 12: 0 new, 0 booked, 3 breached, 3 with contact, 3 unbooked, 0%, 4 partials, 135 min median reply, 0 opted out. The Sep 14 digest had not fired as of 14:12Z (expected ~15:00Z). The digest is formally uninformative — only a direct CRM read can say whether anything moved.

blockers.label: Mary Grossman
blockers.detail: First real $300-Plan lead (NV). Callback window (Fri 6:45 PM PT) now into its third day past; Sep 12 + Sep 13 digests both confirm 0 booked / 3 unbooked / 3 SLA breached. blockers.detail: No watchdog run since Sep 10 17:06Z. The digest lane fires daily at 15:00Z, so this is one specific lane down, not a blanket credit blackout. V2 spend last read ~$72 of the $200 tranche and has had no interpreter for nearly four days.

tasks.lead: Mary Grossman — write the decision down

tasks.lead: Close the compliance gate: b3 (TX reg) + b7 (CA license #)
tasks.detail: Day 18 of live consumer lead flow, still 0/7. The NV lead sits behind this gate; TX dialing needs the telephone-solicitor registration and CA needs the producer license number.

tasks.lead: State the paid motion plainly — keep spending or hold
tasks.detail: V2 tranche last read ~$72 of $200 before the watchdog went quiet ~93h ago, and cost per booked call has never been measured. Decide explicitly rather than letting the budget drain by default with no interpreter watching it.

tasks.lead: Restore whatever the watchdog runs on
tasks.detail: The digest fires daily at 15:00Z but the FA-ADS watchdog has been dark ~93h — a specific lane fault, not a blanket outage. Confirm credits/access and get the interpreter back.
One session unblocks four things: founder ad creative, a creative with his face, the landing-page refresh, and the ElevenLabs voice clone. Shirt + tie, iPhone 4K/60fps, ~20-24 min of takes.

tasks.lead: Open the CRM and answer two questions in one look
tasks.detail: (a) w30: any ad-spend rows timestamped after Sep 11 13:32Z? Rows → the 403 cleared; none → the sync task died. (b) Do the lead rows really read 3 with contact / 3 unbooked / 3 breached, or has the table not been written since Sep 9? The digest can no longer tell — a fifth identical day makes it formally uninformative.

The digest firing on time again (Sep 12 + Sep 13) proves the AI path is not universally dead. Treat the watchdog as its own failure (~93h dark) and find what it is missing — credits, schedule, or a silent crash.

tasks.lead: Make the digest able to change
tasks.detail: If the CRM read shows the table is stale, the digest is reading a frozen source and needs a freshness stamp (last row written) in its header so a frozen read is visible as frozen. If the table is live, the 0% booking rate is real and the number the whole motion is judged on.
Test lead reached the CRM but W1 never sent the welcome email. A lead can currently land and receive nothing — independent of the sync break.

tasks.lead: Wire TurboScribe as a transcript route
tasks.detail: Meeting ingest is 25 days stale at Aug 20 while TurboScribe keeps producing transcripts. Route them in rather than waiting on the Fathom/TwinMind bridge.

Digest alive (fired Sep 12 and Sep 13 at 15:00Z; Sep 14's expected ~15:00Z), watchdog dark ~93h, sync ambiguous ~72h. Do not let the record slide back to "all AI lanes dead" — it is one confirmed-dark lane plus one silence that was never a success signal.

tasks.lead: Log the scoreboard as uninformative, not as 'nothing happened'
tasks.detail: Five identical digests in a row is a property of the instrument, not a fact about the funnel. The record says 'unknown until the CRM is read directly' — never 'quiet'.

tasks.lead: Hold Mary's window as a miss, not an open task
tasks.detail: Seventh ask. It stays on the record as an unrecorded outcome until a human writes called / referred / held — it does not quietly age out of the board.
PM edition generated → curated → synced → published → verified → logged. Eighth consecutive session with a working cloud→Mac bridge; AM chain also completed clean earlier at ~06:35Z.
